items.title: New CRISPR Technique Selectively Shreds Cancer Cells, Including “Undruggable” Cancers
items.summary: The job of a tumor suppressor protein is right in the name: stopping us from getting cancer at the cellular level. But when they’re not working properly, the cell is left with limited defenses.
